entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something. I'm a bit lost with the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... um... VF789012.

Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the ClubFit Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. I just think I got the wrong size. I tried it on and it feels way too tight. I thought I followed the sizing chart, but it's all so confusing. I just want to send it back. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Maria, I'd be happy to sort this out for you. I see here the jersey was delivered 12 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Okay, great news. For our standard apparel like this jersey, VeloFit offers a 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe for a return or an exchange.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried.
No reason to worry at all. We can either process a full refund, or I can set up an exchange for a different size right now. Which would you prefer?
An exchange would be perfect! I'd love to try the next size up. I really like the jersey, it was just too tight.

Excellent choice. And Maria, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. To make this as smooth as possible for you, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. I'll email you a prepaid label right now, and I'm also placing the order for the new size with complimentary expedited shipping. It should be with you in just a couple of days.
Wow, you can do that? That's amazing! Thank you so much, Isaac. You've made this so easy.
It's my pleasure. You'll see that email with the return label in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
